params.instruction: Build a TikZ figure of a 490x340 px image. Use pixel-to-TikZ scale ~0.02 cm per px (x_tikz = x_px*0.02, y_tikz = (340 - y_px)*0.02). Solid outline: quadrilateral with top edge D-C (y=51), left edge D-A, bottom edge A-B (y=288) passing through F(118,288) and N(158,288), right edge C-B. Labels: D(171,51) top-left, C(435,51) top-right, A(53,288) bottom-left, B(316,287) bottom-right, F(118,288) and N(158,288) on bottom edge (small labels below), G(195,217) interior point, E(106,181) interior point (label E is ambiguous, verify by look). Solid interior segments: C-G, B-G-ish (line from B(316,287) through (198,219) to (113,183) area), F-E (from (118,287) to (106,185)). Dashed auxiliary lines (draw dashed, thin): line from C(435,51) through (213,139) to around (160,160); line from (246,174) to (320,293) (ending at B side); line from (223,135) to (97,185); line from (103,174) to (162,295); line from (168,47) to (229,145); line from (202,204) to (152,300). No right angles verified; do not add right-angle marks. Use no external packages beyond tikz. Keep the code compilable standalone and use circles of radius ~1.5pt for points with labels placed with small offsets.
